items.model: GPT-6 Astra (broad availability — ChatGPT paid tiers, API and AWS)
items.basis: Rollout began Sep 4 to Daybreak cyber testers; ChatGPT Plus/Pro/Business/Enterprise, API and AWS follow in days. Polymarket's Sep 15 leg 96%, Sep 30 onward 99-100%.
The 62-scoring max tier is in limited preview for Meta partners with pricing unannounced; a separate max-reasoning mode awaits safety testing.
Musk said Sep 2 it ships in ten days as a 2.1T-parameter pre-train, 40% larger than Grok 4.6. Still no xAI launch page, model card, API ID or benchmarks.
Oct 31 cut to 56% from 69% after fifteen flat sweeps; Sep 30 at 13%, Sep 15 at 4%, on $1.22M volume. Still in partner testing.
OpenAI has said the Ultrafast tier broadens beyond limited access; no date given and no dated market.
Hy4 preview shipped Aug 28; Tencent has not dated the general-availability release and no market exists.
Haiku tier has not been refreshed since 4.5 in Oct 2025; widely expected but unannounced, no dated market.
Zuckerberg says open-weight Muse Spark versions are planned; still no date and no dated market, now that 1.3 has an AA top-three score.
Manifold before-2027 flat at 66% a fourth sweep; before-December 45%, before-November 10%, before-October 3%, before-September 1%.
